articles.title: The Scientist Who Was Called 'Harriet' When All the Men Were 'Doctor'
articles.summary: Imagine being the only woman in a room full of scientists, and while all the men are called 'Doctor,' you're just 'Harriet.' That's what happened to Harriet Robinson, but she didn't let it stop her. She helped create a company making an HIV vaccine and proved you can be a mom and a scientist.

articles.title: A Sticky Gel That Could Help Your Tummy Troubles—By Hanging Out in Your Throat!
articles.summary: Getting medicine to your esophagus (the tube that carries food to your stomach) is super tricky because stuff goes down so fast. MIT scientists made a gooey gel that sticks around and helps drugs soak in. It could help people with painful swelling that makes swallowing hard.
